jobs.title: Operational Excellence Manager Mexico
jobs.description:
Join the best

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company that serves the oil and gas industry in more than 120 countries. Our Pressure Pumping business offers innovative solutions—both physical and digital—that improve efficiency, increase production, and maximize the value of oil and gas fields. As a fundamental part of well construction and production operations, our equipment plays a key role in ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable services for our customers.

Role Summary:
- Responsible for leading and executing integrated projects, ensuring the highest standards of quality, safety, and operational performance. Experienced in strategic leadership, risk management, financial administration, continuous improvement, customer relationship management, and multidisciplinary team coordination. Focused on optimizing business results through the application of PMP methodologies, strengthening the QHSE culture, and driving operational excellence in complex and highly demanding environments. Among my responsibilities are the following:
- Reinforce the company's QHSE policies and actively participate in the compliance and continuous improvement of the Baker Hughes Management System, while maintaining service quality as the foundation of every operation and continuously driving operational excellence.
- Ensure that all work is executed with the highest standards of quality by utilizing iPRA and DRA processes to assess operational readiness and results, while ensuring full compliance with the Service Quality Plan and the 3PV process for integrated projects.
- Lead continuous improvement initiatives for both customer evaluation processes and internal operations, identifying business needs and opportunities to strengthen the company's competitive position in the market.
- Apply Project Management Professional (PMP) methodologies throughout all phases of integrated projects, leading project governance structures, improving operational efficiency, ensuring compliance with organizational standards, and supporting commercial teams in the assessment and mitigation of project-related business risks.
- Manage and control project budgets, costs, and financial objectives throughout the project lifecycle, including the review and approval of expenditures.
- Lead the implementation of solutions and the execution of corrective actions arising from project-related events across Mexico.
- Serve as the integrated operational liaison between customers and managers from each service line, ensuring alignment, communication, and effective project execution.
- Coordinate with the Contracts Manager on monthly project closeouts and contractual matters, as well as with Product Lines, 3PVs, QHSE, and Human Resources regarding staffing, personnel development, and workforce planning.
- Develop annual business plans aligned with the organization's strategic objectives and growth initiatives.
- Be responsible for long-term planning and key management decision-making processes.
- Review and evaluate critical technical services, coordinate operational activities, and make key decisions to ensure safe, efficient, and successful project execution.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering or scientific discipline from an accredited university or relevant industry experience with Integrated Projects.
- Minimum 10+ years of relevant experience in the oil and gas industry
- Comprehensive knowledge of Field Service operations and well construction/Completion.
- Promotes a culture of performance across multiple Product Lines, functions, and external parties.
- Has good understanding of the entire well construction process and operations.
- Excellent leadership, strong interpersonal, influencing and planning skills.
- Demonstrated ability to work in a global matrix organization.
- Understanding of the service delivery process and the technical nature of the business.
- Frequently visit the Baker Hughes base and the TPVs base to review tool failure investigations and conduct quality assurance checks on the equipment.

Desired Characteristics/Skills:

- Manages written and oral English as a working language.
- Decision-making and Situational Leadership skills in diverse geographic and cultural environments
- Strong digital literacy (MAPS/FRACAS, BHOS, MtJC, MtPC, MS Tools)
- Strong data capture and clear, concise reporting skills
- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
- Strong interpersonal and relationship skills
- Advanced knowledge of:
- Continuous Improvement systems and visual management
- Reliability engineering and root cause/corrective action
- Performance management systems and strategy deployment
- Project Management, Risk Management, and MOC
- Management Systems and Three Lines of Defense modeling

- Reports to: Latam Operational Excellence Manager (Services Manager - Service Delivery Management)

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that every person is different and that the way they work and perform at their best is unique to them. That’s why we offer work arrangements that support both our operational needs and the well-being of our employees.

This position operates on a rotating schedule that may include day and night shifts. Specific details regarding the schedule will be shared during the selection process.

Working with Us

Our people are at the heart of everything we do at Baker Hughes. We know we achieve better results when our employees are engaged, developed, and able to bring their full potential to work. We invest in well-being, talent development, and leadership programs to help our teams succeed.

Working for You

Our innovations have transformed the energy industry for over a century. To continue building the future of energy, we value and reward people who embrace challenges and make a positive impact.

When you join Baker Hughes, you’ll enjoy:
Modern work-life balance policies and wellness programs.
Comprehensive private health care options.
Life and disability insurance programs.
Financial programs tailored to your needs.
Additional voluntary and optional benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Services Manager - Service Delivery Management

Planning, Forecasting & Reporting

- Regional and product mix performance

- Applied labor time and productivity metrics

- As-sold versus as-executed margin analysis

- Supporting billing, collections, and past-due management activities

- Material costs

- Freight and logistics expenses

- Inventory levels and inventory turns

- Manufacturing variances

- Productivity initiatives and cost savings programs

- Supporting inventory accounting and working capital management activities

- Leading burden rate calculations and productivity performance measurements

Fuel your passion

- Have a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field

- Strong interpersonal and leadership capabilities

- Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business problems and develop practical solutions

- Proven ability to lead projects and drive cross-functional initiatives

- Ability to develop, document, plan, and execute finance and operational programs

- Established project management and organizational skills

- Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

- Advanced proficiency with financial systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Excel

jobs.title: Lean Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
Lean Transformation Lead

Are you passionate about leading Lean transformation and operational excellence within a complex engineering environment?
Do you enjoy partnering with technical teams to drive continuous improvement and deliver sustainable business results?

Join our innovative team
At Baker Hughes Flexible Pipe Systems (FPS), we design and manufacture industry-leading flexible pipe technologies that support offshore energy projects around the world. Our Newcastle facility has been operating for more than 25 years, delivering engineering excellence and innovative solutions for some of the industry's most demanding applications.
As part of our continued transformation journey, we are looking for a Lean Transformation Lead to support Engineering Design and Project Execution teams in driving continuous improvement, Lean maturity, and operational excellence across the organization.

Partner with the best
As a Lean Transformation Lead, you will be a trusted advisor to Engineering and Project Execution teams, helping them embed Lean principles into everyday work practices. You will support the delivery of our established Lean Journey programme while shaping the future roadmap, strategy, and priorities for operational excellence.
Working closely with technical teams, site leadership, Supply Chain Lean professionals, and global FPS colleagues, you will help improve productivity, quality, delivery performance, and customer outcomes through structured continuous improvement initiatives.

As a Lean Transformation Lead, you will be responsible for:
- Supporting the continued delivery and evolution of the Engineering Lean Journey programme while helping define future operational excellence priorities.
- Developing Lean strategies, roadmaps, and improvement plans aligned with Engineering, Project Execution, site, and business objectives.
- Partnering with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities and translate them into structured initiatives.
- Facilitating Lean workshops, Kaizen events, Value Stream Mapping exercises, and problem-solving sessions to drive measurable business improvements.
- Coaching and mentoring teams in the practical application of Lean principles, methods, and continuous improvement behaviours.
- Supporting root cause analysis, process optimization, workflow improvements, and the elimination of non-value-added activities.
- Establishing governance, performance metrics, visual management systems, and Lean maturity assessments to measure progress and sustain results.
- Collaborating with global FPS Lean teams and supporting cross-site improvement initiatives, including occasional international travel.

Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role, you will:
- Have significant experience in Lean, Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement, or Business Transformation within Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or Project Execution environments.
- Have experience leading or supporting Lean transformation programmes within complex technical organizations.
- Demonstrate strong practical knowledge of Lean methodologies and tools, including Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Root Cause Analysis, A3 Problem Solving, DMAIC, and Visual Management.
- Possess excellent facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management, and communication skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
- Have experience working with engineering and project teams to improve processes, quality, delivery performance, and operational effectiveness.
- Demonstrate a track record of delivering measurable and sustainable business improvements through Lean initiatives.
- Be comfortable using operational metrics and data-driven insights to drive decision-making and continuous improvement.
- Be willing to work primarily from the Newcastle office and travel internationally when required.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, Technology, Operations Management, Business Improvement, or a related discipline.
- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification or equivalent advanced Lean qualification.
- Formal training in Lean methodologies such as Value Stream Mapping, A3 Problem Solving, DMAIC, Standard Work, Visual Management, 6S, and Root Cause Analysis.

Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way people work and deliver at their best varies from person to person. In this role, we can offer the following working pattern:
- Primarily site-based at our Newcastle upon Tyne facility.
- Opportunity to work from home 1 day a week
- Occasional international travel to other FPS global locations

We invest in the health and wellbeing of our workforce, train and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

You will partner with field teams, sales, and engineering to ensure high‑quality application support, identify customer opportunities, and deliver innovative chemical solutions that drive value and long‑term growth.

As an Area Operations Manager, you will be responsible for:
- Building and maintaining long‑term, strategic customer relationships to originate sales opportunities and develop business growth strategies across the assigned area.

- Supporting field activities including sampling, testing, application maintenance, and routine performance reporting for existing customers.

- Supporting the development, installation, and optimization of systems and designs that apply chemical products and technologies.

- Partnering with Sales and Engineering teams to develop and deliver customer presentations focused on value creation, reliability, and process improvement.

- Identifying, coordinating, and managing multiple projects of varying complexity that deliver measurable value to customers.

- Promoting safe, compliant, and consistent service execution in alignment with Baker Hughes standards.

Fuel Your Passion

- Have a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.

- Have a minimum of 5 years of experience in hydrocarbon process treatment or water treatment applications, including wastewater, boiler, and cooling systems.

- Demonstrate a solid understanding of industrial chemical treatment technologies and the technical sales process.

- Exhibit strong mechanical aptitude and effective troubleshooting skills.

- Have previous laboratory experience or familiarity with analytical methods and data interpretation.
